SELECT t.*, c.* FROM accounts_customuser t LEFT JOIN accounts_emailverification c ON c.user_id = t.id;

SELECT * FROM accounts_customuser ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT strftime('string', date_joined) as period, COUNT(*) as count FROM accounts_customuser WHERE date_joined >= 'date' GROUP BY parent_id ORDER BY date_joined;
SELECT email, COUNT(*) as count FROM accounts_customuser GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT * FROM accounts_customuser LEFT JOIN emaildigest_anonymoussubscription ON accounts_customuser.id = emaildigest_anonymoussubscription.subscription_ptr_id LEFT JOIN accounts_invitation ON accounts_customuser.used_invitation_id = accounts_invitation.id;
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY last_login ORDER BY id DESC) as rn FROM accounts_customuser ) WHERE rn = 1;
SELECT * FROM accounts_customuser WHERE is_superuser > (SELECT AVG(is_superuser) FROM accounts_customuser)
WITH grouped AS ( SELECT last_login, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM accounts_customuser GROUP BY last_login ) SELECT * FROM grouped WHERE cnt > num ORDER BY cnt DESC;
SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY date_joined) as running_count FROM accounts_customuser ORDER BY date_joined;
